findings.title: A rejected device is cached, so its next request bypasses the limit
findings.body: `tagDeviceUI` inserts the device ID into the local cache before attempting the store write. When the store rejects a new device at the limit, this error is now returned here, but the cache entry is not removed. A retry from that device hits the cache and returns success without checking the limit, so the user authenticates anonymously for the cache lifetime without being recorded. Remove the cache entry when the store write fails, or only cache successful writes.

findings.title: The count-then-insert check can exceed the configured limit
findings.body: The device count and subsequent insert run as separate database operations with no transaction or serialization. If the count is one below the limit, concurrent requests for different devices can both observe that count and both insert, exceeding the configured limit. Enforce the check and insert atomically (or otherwise serialize limit decisions) so concurrent requests cannot overrun it.
